title: Frozen qualification policy for standardized cross-sectional research metrics (R4)
authority: controller R4 brief 2026-09-25 (amends plan-s2 section 8.3 R4) and controller rebind ruling 2026-09-25 (v2: labeled cap-tercile size-bucket fallback; deflated Sharpe reported, not gating); rulings RX1 (labeled bases) and RX7 (frozen before real data: no real-data result existed under v1)

primary.rationale: 3 months is the pre-registered medium horizon: with month-end formations from 2012 and a 2024 holdout the selection sample keeps >=120 IC observations and the holdout keeps an EWC df of 3; 6 and 12 months are reported (decay), never selected on

deflated_sharpe.meaning: reported and flagged (dsr_pass = dsr_z > 0, i.e. SR beats E[max SR | whole family] at horizon_periods = h), never gating: HLZ / BH+|z|>=2, holdout, subperiods and the size-bucket sign rule handle multiplicity

size_buckets.meaning: point-in-time NYSE 20/50 breakpoints where both buckets have >= min_formations formations, else the verified-cap tercile slices R3b emits; the rule gates either way and the ledger row records which (size_venue_basis)
